name: Perplexity
summary: AI answer engine with cited sources and research agents.
description: Perplexity is an AI answer engine that searches the web and answers with cited sources, and now includes 'Computer' for building documents and apps, deep research and a choice of top models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and others. A free plan is available; Pro costs $17/month billed annually and Max $167/month billed annually, and it also makes the free Comet browser.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: A free plan is available; Pro costs $17/month billed annually and Max $167/month billed annually, and it also makes the free Comet browser.

features: Cited Answers: Provides real-time responses with source citations.
Web Search Integration: Combines AI and live web data.
Follow-Up Queries: Enables contextual back-and-forth questioning.
Multimodal Inputs: Accepts both text and voice prompts.
